notes: Launchpad: clicking an app opens it again (a click was being taken as a click on the background, which only closed Launchpad)

App Store: the Open button now starts apps the same way Launchpad and the Dock do, shows Opening…, and tells you why if an app could not start; clicking a button on an app's card no longer also opens the app's page
Resize the Dock like on a Mac: drag either end of the Dock up or down. Right-click an end for Magnification, Hiding, Small / Medium / Large and Dock Settings
The Dock always fits the screen: with many apps open its icons shrink a little and return to your size afterwards, and a Dock that locks up is restarted automatically
